```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(corrplot)
library(car)
library(broom)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)
```

```{r load-data}
df_raw <- read_csv("C:/Users/velan/OneDrive/Desktop/DS project/pudb_master_clean.csv")

cat("Rows:", nrow(df_raw), " | Cols:", ncol(df_raw), "\n")

df <- df_raw %>%
  select(
    ltv          = LTVRatioPercent,
    dti          = TotalDebtExpenseRatioPercent,
    income       = TotalMonthlyIncomeAmount,
    credit_score = min_credit_score,
    age          = avg_age,
    first_time   = BorrowerFirstTimeHomebuyer,
    note_rate    = NoteRatePercent,
    loan_purpose = LoanPurposeType,
    prop_use     = PropertyUsageType
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    first_time_fct = factor(first_time,
                            levels = c(0, 1),
                            labels = c("Not First-Time", "First-Time")),
    credit_grp = factor(credit_score,
                        levels = 1:5,
                        labels = c("Poor (<620)",
                                   "Below Fair (620-659)",
                                   "Fair (660-699)",
                                   "Good (700-759)",
                                   "Excellent (760+)")),
    loan_purpose_fct = factor(loan_purpose,
                              levels = c(1, 2, 6),
                              labels = c("Purchase", "Refinance", "Cash-Out Refi")),
    prop_use_fct = factor(prop_use,
                          levels = c(1, 2),
                          labels = c("Primary", "Investment/Second")),
    income_band = case_when(
      income < 5000  ~ "Low (<$5k/mo)",
      income < 10000 ~ "Lower-Mid ($5-10k)",
      income < 20000 ~ "Upper-Mid ($10-20k)",
      TRUE           ~ "High (>$20k/mo)"
    ),
    income_band = factor(income_band,
                         levels = c("Low (<$5k/mo)", "Lower-Mid ($5-10k)",
                                    "Upper-Mid ($10-20k)", "High (>$20k/mo)"))
  )

cat("\nKey variable summary:\n")
summary(df[c("ltv", "dti", "income", "credit_score", "age")])
```

```{r eda-distributions}
# 2a. DTI distribution
p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = dti)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#d7191c", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(30, 43), color = "darkred",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 32, y = Inf, label = "30% threshold",
           vjust = 2, color = "darkred", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 45, y = Inf, label = "43% threshold",
           vjust = 2, color = "darkred", size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of DTI Ratio",
       x = "DTI (%)", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# 2b. LTV distribution (for reference)
p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = ltv)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#2c7bb6", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 80, color = "red",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of LTV Ratio (Reference)",
       x = "LTV (%)", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)
```

```{r eda-dti-by-groups}
# DTI by credit score group
ggplot(df, aes(x = credit_grp, y = dti, fill = credit_grp)) +

       x = "Credit Score Group", y = "DTI (%)") +
```



```{r eda-dti-income-band}

ggplot(df, aes(x = income_band, y = dti, fill = income_band)) +
```

```{r eda-correlation}
# Correlation matrix
cor_vars <- df %>%
  select(ltv, dti, income, credit_score, age, first_time, note_rate) %>%
  cor(use = "complete.obs")

corrplot(cor_vars,
         method    = "color",
         type      = "upper",
         addCoef.col = "black",
         tl.col    = "black",
         tl.srt    = 45,
         title     = "Correlation Matrix — Key Variables",
         mar       = c(0, 0, 1, 0))
```

```{r train-test-split}
# 3a. Train / Test Split (80/20)
set.seed(123)
train_idx  <- createDataPartition(df$dti, p = 0.80, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- df[-train_idx, ]

cat("\nTrain rows:", nrow(train_data),
    " | Test rows:", nrow(test_data), "\n")
```

```{r fit-model}
# 3b. Fit OLS Model — DTI as dependent variable
model_dti <- lm(
  dti ~ income + credit_score + age + first_time +
        ltv + loan_purpose + prop_use,
  data = train_data
)

cat("\n Financial Risk Model (DTI) \n")
print(summary(model_dti))
```

```{r coefficient-table}
# 3c. Tidy Coefficient Table
cat("\nCoefficient Table:\n")
print(tidy(model_dti, conf.int = TRUE))
```

```{r vif-check}
# 3d. VIF — Multicollinearity Check
cat("\nVIF (values >5 indicate multicollinearity):\n")
print(vif(model_dti))
```

```{r test-metrics}
# 3e. Predict on Test Set and Compute Metrics
preds_dti <- predict(model_dti, newdata = test_data)

r2_test  <- cor(preds_dti, test_data$dti)^2
rmse_dti <- RMSE(preds_dti, test_data$dti)
mae_dti  <- MAE(preds_dti, test_data$dti)

cat(sprintf("\n Test Set Performance \n"))
cat(sprintf(" R²   : %.4f\n", r2_test))
cat(sprintf(" RMSE : %.4f\n", rmse_dti))
cat(sprintf(" MAE  : %.4f\n", mae_dti))
```

```{r cross-validation}
# 3f. 5-Fold Cross-Validation
cv_ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5)

model_cv <- train(
  dti ~ income + credit_score + age + first_time +
        ltv + loan_purpose + prop_use,
  data      = train_data,
  method    = "lm",
  trControl = cv_ctrl
)

cat("\n 5-Fold Cross-Validation \n")
print(model_cv$results)
```

```{r residual-diagnostics}
# 3g. Residual Diagnostics
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(model_dti, main = "DTI Model — Residual Diagnostics")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r predicted-vs-actual}
# 3h. Predicted vs Actual Plot
pred_df <- data.frame(actual = test_data$dti, predicted = preds_dti)

ggplot(pred_df, aes(x = actual, y = predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = "#d7191c", size = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red",
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Financial Risk Model: Predicted vs Actual DTI",
       subtitle = sprintf("Test R² = %.4f | RMSE = %.2f | MAE = %.2f",
                          r2_test, rmse_dti, mae_dti),
       x = "Actual DTI (%)", y = "Predicted DTI (%)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r coefficient-plot}
# 3i. Coefficient Plot
coef_df <- tidy(model_dti, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    significant = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "p<0.05", "p>0.05"),
    term = case_when(
      term == "income"       ~ "Monthly Income",
      term == "credit_score" ~ "Credit Score (1-5)",
      term == "age"          ~ "Avg Age",
      term == "first_time"   ~ "First-Time Buyer",
      term == "ltv"          ~ "LTV Ratio",
      term == "loan_purpose" ~ "Loan Purpose",
      term == "prop_use"     ~ "Property Use",
      TRUE ~ term
    )
  )

ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = reorder(term, estimate),
                    y = estimate, color = significant)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("p<0.05" = "#2c7bb6", "p>0.05" = "#d7191c")) +
  labs(title = "Coefficient Plot — Financial Risk Model (DTI)",
       subtitle = "Error bars = 95% CI",
       x = NULL, y = "Coefficient Estimate", color = "Significance") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r final-summary}
# 4. Final Summary
cat("\n", strrep("=", 50), "\n")
cat("FINANCIAL RISK MODEL (DTI) — FINAL RESULTS\n")
cat(strrep("=", 50), "\n")
cat(sprintf("Training R²   : %.4f\n", summary(model_dti)$r.squared))
cat(sprintf("Adjusted R²   : %.4f\n", summary(model_dti)$adj.r.squared))
cat(sprintf("Test R²       : %.4f\n", r2_test))
cat(sprintf("Test RMSE     : %.4f\n", rmse_dti))
cat(sprintf("Test MAE      : %.4f\n", mae_dti))
cat(sprintf("CV R²         : %.4f\n", model_cv$results$Rsquared))
cat("\nAll variables and their significance:\n")
print(tidy(model_dti) %>%
        select(term, estimate, p.value) %>%
        mutate(significant = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "YES", "NO")) %>%
        arrange(p.value))
```
